criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given Service point details are loading, the detail presentation shows a loading state without displaying incorrect detail data.
criterionOutcomes.reason: SIMULATED UI STATE: UI-only loading check on https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com. The selected result records an exact-origin POST /api/platform/automobile/service/cluster-details route restricted to pointId 131928146, holding the original read about 30 seconds without modifying its response; unmatched requests fell through. Contract provenance is the target's genuine HTTP 200 request/response established before interception, with no fabricated empty or successful response. criterion-7-valid-baseline.png and criterion-7-before-held-load.png show distinct prior point 131928136 (13:32:47, -116 dBm, serving cell 2592_130_4); criterion-7-before-target-selection.png shows the selection table. criterion-7-target-genuine-baseline.png identifies target 131928146 by 13:32:42, -112 dBm and serving cell 70888_120_4. criterion-7-final.png shows only a loading spinner in the entire active detail presentation, without prior fields or neighbours. criterion-7-recovery.png matches the genuine target baseline after release. The structured tester steps record finally releasing the original read, removing only the exact owned handler/reference and completing UI cleanup with no pending interception. Visible recovery corroborates the cleanup; this establishes controlled loading UI behavior, not natural latency or backend success through simulation.

coverageChecks.assertion: Loading Service point details shows a visible loading indicator
Loading target 131928146 does not display incorrect or stale details from baseline 131928136
Releasing the original request recovers genuine target details and removes the owned simulation

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given loading Service point details fails, the detail presentation shows an error state and does not show incorrect detail data.
criterionOutcomes.reason: SIMULATED UI STATE: UI-only failed-read check on https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com. Only the criterion-9-restart sequence supports this review. The tester records an exact-origin POST /api/platform/automobile/service/cluster-details handler restricted to pointId 131928146, fulfilling one matching read with standard HTTP 503 Service Unavailable and text/plain 'Service Unavailable'; unmatched requests fell through. Provenance is the target's genuine read/HTTP 200 baseline and standard failed HTTP status, not a failed measurement, empty-response contract or observed backend outage. criterion-9-restart-before-error.png shows distinct prior point 131928136 (13:32:47, -116 dBm, serving cell 2592_130_4); criterion-9-restart-before-target.png shows the target selection table. criterion-9-restart-target-genuine.png identifies target 131928146 by 13:32:42, -112 dBm and serving cell 70888_120_4. criterion-9-restart-final.png shows 'Unable to load point details.' and Retry with no stale serving fields or neighbours in the active presentation. Tester steps record removing only the exact handler/reference in finally before Retry. criterion-9-restart-recovery.png then matches the genuine target details; criterion-9-restart-cleanup.png shows owned detail tabs and layer removed. Recovery corroborates removal and the tester records no remaining handler. This proves controlled error UI handling only.

coverageChecks.assertion: A failed Service detail request shows a standard error state
The failed target request does not show incorrect or stale details from baseline point 131928136
After exact handler removal, Retry recovers genuine target 131928146 details
